scope: Frozen full-stream synthetic adult false-trigger challenges
source: Windows offline Microsoft Zira Desktop, adult female en-US, rate 0, volume 100; 16 kHz mono PCM16.
expected_policy: Literal endpoint semantics: actual wrong words, omissions, prompts and skipped anchors should not emit. Correct and reread cases should emit once. Pronunciation-tolerant acceptance can conflict with this strict wrong-word requirement.

pre_audio_setup_failures.reason: Snapshot copy attempted to open __pycache__ as a file; no synthesis or ASR challenge trials ran.

matcher_only_text_diagnostics.kind: Constructed word-by-word text snapshots, not ASR/audio trials

limits: Synthetic adult speech and constructed pauses, not children or real room audio.
A scripted synthesis request is not an independent human transcript; review failures with the audio and saved ASR.
The required-word observer is a predeclared policy comparison, not a production-manifest change or a guarantee against close spelling.
Challenge counts are designed counterexamples, not population precision/recall or child-reading accuracy.
Both manifest policies share each stream. The required-word observer was predeclared; production manifests were not tightened.
The previous matcher is replayed on identical current ASR callbacks; this is not an ASR-model comparison.
Final ASR can differ from the trigger snapshot. Trigger context is recorded separately.
Required-word checks can reject valid ASR substitutions and cannot prevent false triggers when ASR itself substitutes the expected word.
